Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1075189 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Sort by compound identifier ascending.
